steps.u: Our three importers each copy-paste the same retry-with-backoff code. Pull it into one helper.

steps.a: The three copies differ slightly: one retries on HTTP 429 as well, and one has no jitter. A shared helper should take the retryable exceptions as a parameter and add jitter, otherwise concurrent workers retry in lockstep.

reference.summary: Replaced three copy-pasted retry loops in the importers with one shared retry helper that takes the retryable exceptions as a parameter and adds jitter to the backoff; the import tests still pass.
facts: three importers had duplicated retry code

decisions.choice: add jitter and make retryable exceptions a parameter
decisions.reason: concurrent workers would otherwise retry in lockstep and one importer also retries on rate limits
